question.problem:
Find $\lim_\limits{x\rightarrow \,-1}f(x)$ for the function $f(x)$ whose graph is shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14198813/assets/eead78a813f820cf12cbd05bd22b230b1753c7e4ebe1e77d2c1eb6b61c11f4ed.png)
question.worked_solution:
As $x$ approaches $-1,$ the value of $f(x)$ approaches $2.$ Consequently, 

$$
\lim_\limits{x\rightarrow \,-1}f(x)=2\,.
$$
